blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) rescued 34 persons after their motorized banca encountered engine trouble in Taytay Bay in Palawan on Monday. The passengers were aboard MBCA Kin J-Mar, which was traveling to Barangay Casian in Taytay, to visit the graves of their departed loved ones, the Coast Guard District Palawan said. Coast Guard Sub-Station Taytay received a distress call from a concerned citizen at 3:30 p.m. and immediately dispatched a search and rescue team to the reported location.
